Root-owned fork of braces 3.0.3 for GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, which has no patched upstream release. The original API, source and MIT license are retained. String parsing and AST traversal are bounded before recursive work at every low-level public operation. The private @litter/braces name identifies this local implementation replacement; it is not an upstream fixed release. Limits: 64 levels, 65536 input characters, 100000 AST nodes.
